contracts.archive: original relative paths and every original byte; metadata/empty directories excluded
contracts.inputs: whole directory, .git excluded explicitly, symlinks rejected; immutable SHA-256 manifest
contracts.pack: preloaded original byte inputs -> complete serialized archive; pool setup/teardown included
contracts.restore: complete serialized archive -> parsed, decoded, owned original bytes
contracts.latency: separate codec_reset and repeat_after_one_prime loops; reset before every query; explicit prime before repeat
contracts.os_cache: uncontrolled; no cold physical IO claim
contracts.cache: VPK and indexed controls:16 blocks; ZIP:no decoded member cache; not equal-byte caches
contracts.timing: integer monotonic nanoseconds; no observer subtraction; no sampler threads in measured region
contracts.integrity: every full restore SHA-256; every read exact original bytes or SHA-256 control path; no skipped validation
contracts.quality: RGB-only sRGB pooled MSE/PSNR; alpha separate; linear RGB MSE; Pillow DDS reference; FLIP RGB LDR ppd=67
contracts.pixels: Pillow convert RGBA; no resize, EXIF transpose or ICC transform; input color interpretation sRGB for Kodak only
contracts.statistics: rounds are replication units; nearest-rank within-round quantiles; bootstrap medians across rounds; descriptive only
contracts.tail: expected tail count is coverage diagnostic, not precision guarantee or production SLO
contracts.selection: all registered cases; predetermined randomized order; retain all outliers and failed attempts; no adaptive stopping
contracts.resource: same CPU affinity allowance; no global power/cache changes; sequential measured workers

regression.interpretation: descriptive paired-round operational gate; multiple comparisons not population significance; ambiguous CI is inconclusive
regression.harness_equivalence: functional only; never attribute harness timing changes to codecs
